title.label: Best iOS podcast player on the market!

content.label: Loving the new refresh! Overcast is still the best podcast app out there for iOS. I’ve been using it since its early days, and have tried the competition a few times but always ended up coming back to Overcast. I love the refreshed interface, and after a couple of days of use, muscle memory is back. Its features like Voice Boost still means the best voice clarity especially when in loud environments.

Everything you need.
Nothing you don’t need.
Easy to use.
Great audio.
Really enjoying the new update. Appreciate that there are still some rough edges but the new layout really works for me. Much improved over the old version!

title.label: This is NOT a one star app

content.label:
Core functionality.
99.99% of the functionality of this app is simply playing audio, which it performs flawlessly at a quality equal or better to any other podcast app.

Smart speed. Amazing.

Developer dedication.
Marco truly sweats over every detail and is responsive if you have feedback or a complaint.

User interface. Largely excellent.
(as of August 24 currently a work in progress due to a major rewrite).

It is 100% certain that the UI and any bugs will be ironed out very soon.

Be fair with your reviews.

The mid-2024 Update made so many nice little improvements. It really shows a depth of care. Everything is very nicely done. My only complaint is the removal of streaming to start playing a show. I’m guessing I can overcome this 99% by setting my regular podcatss to all download proactively. Internet in other parts of the world (like Australia) isn’t always great, so this effect can be magnified eg waiting tens of seconds if not minutes before something new starts playing. (And phone storage size to download as many podcasts as I would want to pushes you up a storage tier for many). I get the tradeoffs in complexity and especially now there are dynamic length inserte ads (good discussion on ATP about this btw). So still not sure if this is worth addressing on the app side, or just noting and working around on the user side.

My favourite “nice touch” feature: if you have a sleep timer on, it expires, then you hit play again from the lock screen, it plays with the sleep timer again rather than infinitely. So it’s less work than unlocking the phone and setting up another timer. Great when you’re half asleep.

It was great, the update has flooded my feed with episodes that had been completed, and episodes that aren't downloaded. Now while listening it will just stop for minutes while it decides if it can download the next episode.

This used to be my absolute favourite app that I recommended to everyone. The new update has absolutely ruined the experience. It's a massive step backwards. 
1) controls are harder to access. Particularly the most useful ones like change podcast speed and sleep timer. Now it requires multiple actions rather than swiping the screen. 
2) streaming episodes no longer works so it get stuck when podcast changes and you have to open the app and make sure it's downloading the episodes and then wait rather than it just progressing and playing the next episode
3) when on all episode screen you can't skip forward or back on currently playing episode, for some reason those buttons have been removed. 

Overall this used to be a great app but has been ruined.  Please bring back the old layout or have it as an option. A perfect app that just worked has been ruined unfortunately.

title.label: New changes have made it much worse

content.label: This is still a decent podcasting service but the recent changes have made it much harder to navigate podcasts where you are downloading certain episodes and not just subscribing to the stream. You used to be able to have different settings for Current vs All and more easily see which episodes are downloaded. Please change it back!

The recent makeover of this app is horrid. 
Give us back the old simpler app. 
Why change something that was not broken. 
I have used this app for years but now looking for another option
Great update and easier to navigate
Still great. An excellent refresh to the best podcast player out there!
Easy to use with great power features under the hood. I love smart speed
Latest update has turned this app into a clunky mess is there any way to dl the old overcas?
It’s pretty much where the old button was, with a different icon. Reviews saying sleep timer has been removed haven’t spent more than a few seconds trying to find it
I don’t like the new page and setup - looking for another podcast now

Have been using the app for years and years and the latest update has made it completely unusable. App takes an age to open and you can’t stream episodes?? Downloading episodes is also buggy and often doesn’t work at all.

It was once the best podcast app until the redesign and now it’s honestly terrible. The fact you now have to download podcasts and have no option to stream is probably the worst and biggest impact on user experience. I’m definitely planning to switch podcast apps.
New design is fantastic. Thought out, works well.

Author is arrogantly dismissing and mocking customers as being resistant to change, but the reality is, the new version is tremendously buggy, often outright broken, and missing a ton of old features.

title.label: One of the best made apps! ❤️❤️

content.label: Love the new design and the effort you have put into it. I have used it regularly for last couple of years and it has been rock solid ❤️❤️

I’ve been an Overcast user from the very beginning, and even after the recent rewrite, it’s still the best podcast player around, mostly because of its solid fundamentals - Smart Speed and Voice Boost are genuinely best-in-class. And while the UI has never been revolutionary, it mostly stayed out of your way and let you get to what’s most important - get the content into your skull, with sublime technical finesse.

The recent rewrite, like all rewrites, are disorienting, which makes things worse for no particular reason. It’s the trap that nearly all software eventually falls into: the belief that users care about how things work. What users actually want is for the software to be invisible, and changing a large proportion of the UI and some fundamental aspects of the UX is not how you make software invisible.

Regardless, I’ll eventually get used to the New Way of Things, and those things that annoy me now will fade into muscle memory, and I’ll continue using the best podcast player around, in the best the audio can sound (something I’m constantly reminded of whenever I use any other podcast or audiobook apps). I’ve pinged it a star because I’m now conscious of all its worts, but it’ll go back to 5 stars as soon as I forget.

title.label: Not as good as it was

content.label:
I was delighted when I found Overcast as it allowed me to manage playlists as I liked, and was superior to the native iOS app in every way (other than search). 
However, the recent major update (which I understand the need for in terms of the underlying code) has made downloading and playing podcasts much harder and less intuitive, to the point I might start looking around again for another app. Hoping the feedback about functionality is heard and responded to soon.
It looks fresh and seems snappier - still love the smart speed!

I loved this app, but the new update took a couple of really unique features away. The main one is sleep timer on the main screen, and being able to set custom sleep timer duration. I’m not exaggerating when I say I used this daily. Every single day. It may seem like a small thing, but this has significantly and negatively impacted my user experience of using this app. I’m actively looking for a replacement app that has this feature now.
Only wish would be having an easy way to access Shows from an Episode. It’s a bit hard to figure out the … button to access your show settings.
Apples app and Spotify don’t come close. For a solo dev app, it’s incredible!
I’ve used the app for a least 8 years & screen time tells me I use it for half an hour per day.

App was working great for years but the latest update has killed the experience for me. Used to be able to select a pod episode and set it to “Play next” which doesn’t appear anymore. Can only “ Add to queue”, which would be fine except the queue doesn’t auto-play anymore either, so what’s even the point? This latest update really has me questioning my ongoing use of the app…
A great update
I’ve been using Overcast since its initial release. The latest is a full rewrite and you can feel it in the speed of every action. So fast, still great, love it.

Love that Marco has totally reengineered the underlying code to allow for future development. Don’t get put off by minor complaints in the rewrite. Most issues have been fixed already and the future looks exciting.

title.label: Been using for years. But new design / dev is buggy

content.label:
My go to podcast app for nearly a decade. Love the bravery of a new design. And I know it’s still in the works. But lots of bugs that stop me from being able to download podcasts. 

Have to restart the app each time as the progress download animation stops. Have to cancel down load and start again. 

Love the new design. Hopefully it gets to a point I can listen to casts again soo.

Sad to see a once great ap get updated to be a worse, slower experience.

Streaming gone so now clicking a new episode can take minutes to play. It also takes 2 clicks as tap to play is gone. (Added back still slow without streaming)

 To download the episode ahead of time is now hidden behind 2 menus, no more swipe. 

 Viewing episode information is now hidden in a menu. No swipe to view. Clicking artwork reveals it but not dismisses. 

 Sleep timer hidden behind menu. Then a second menu to select duration. No idea how to get to a shows page from info. Assume the feature is removed. 

 Apple Watch functionality still completely broken and buggy, the one aspect that I’d welcome an update to. 

 Genuinely don’t understand how people are claiming the new update is faster, every function from playing, downloading, sleep timer, reading information is objectively slower. Makes me wonder if there is purchased reviews going up.

Just discovered OPML export has been removed making switching to another podcast player harder. Hard to believe that was accidental.

title.label: Thanks but no thanks for the update

content.label: Loved this app and it’s been a mainstay for me for years. However the latest major update has completely changed the way playlists are managed - what used to be a pleasure has now become a frustration. The search for the perfect podcast app resumes…

The latest update is a little jarring but I guess we’ll get used to it. One of my podcasts (YWA) though now lists every past episode twice. Also lost the ability to sort All Episodes by oldest first.

Also I know have lots of trouble downloading and listening. Streaming was good. It now takes several attempts to download a podcast first.
I have no issues recommending Overcast.

This app is made for people who listen to podcasts on the regular. Lots of attention to detail, thoughtful and innovative features, this is app is to podcasts what a well paired wine is for a lovingly prepared dish. Bon Appetit!

The rewrite has been a big change, I used to use streaming and I’m sad to see it go but the new update has the same level of care and attention as it has always had. Here’s to the next 10 years of overcast!

EDIT: I found it.

I can’t figure out how to Add To Up Next (or add to queue) I miss the old design. Will probably uninstall if this Isn’t fixed

Was a good, reliable, functional podcast app. Latest ‘upgrades’ have made downloading from wifi unreliable and over cell network impossible. Can no longer filter to see subscribed podcasts with new content and rules to prevent downloading of ancient podcasts have disappeared or been over-ridden. Fairly hoping anoyer upgrade may have some fixes but if not I’ll be off to pocket or the old apple podcast app
Been using it for years. The most reliable, easy to use and user friendly solution out there. Whatever you are using right now, just stop. This is better
Have used it for years. Just keeps getting better. I really like the rewrite. Bravo.

Latest update keeps stopping the podcast halfway through then deletes it. Don’t like having to go into each podcast to see if there are new episodes. Strange numbers next to podcasts don’t relate to episodes in the podcast etc not a fan of the changes.

Used to be an obviously five star app. Far less practical now without access to the back and forward arrows from anywhere in the app, or the swipe left and right to access info and speed controls. But it’s the playlists refusing to stay in my manually arranged order which might see me switch to a different app with poorer sound quality.
Does everything I need. Does it well. This is a fine example of devotion and care given by small independent developers. Thank you.

I love Overcast! I’ve been a happy user for 10 years. The new redesign has completely fixed the hangs I used to experience when scrolling through my podcast list and resuming playback. My phone is pretty old so I had assumed that was the issue, but Overcast is now buttery smooth and running like a champ again. Thanks for the big update and looking forward to some iterations.
Just works well and aligns with my way of listening.

title.label: No longer playing next ep in playlist post July 2024 update

content.label: PLEASE FIX - since the July 2024 update, episodes in a playlist no longer plays continuously / autoplay. You have to manually go into the app and click play on the new podcast. PLEASE FIX THIS, IT IS SO ANNOYING. if it ain’t broken, don’t tinker with it…since this new update I’ve even gone so far as to look for a new podcast player - given how un-user friendly this app has become. Please change it back to how it was! Thank you

title.label: New version has removed some features I liked

content.label: Mainly disappointed that quick access to “sleep” timer and ability to easily adjust sleep time now requires opening extra menu levels … so you can’t quickly “add” time to sleep timer,… my most used feature ….
…by a wide margin, too. The new rewritten version is also a significant advance. Well done.

title.label: New version does not automatically play next episodes

content.label: For a playlist I created. Once the current podcast end, it no longer play the next one automatically. Might be related with the new behavior of downloading the entire episode before start playing.
